what is this error ? +- compile exe reactjit-dev ReleaseFast native 1 errors
framework/events/editor_bus.zig:38:24: error: no module named 'sqlite' available within module 'root'
const sqlite = @import("sqlite");
                 lol
resolution: Diagnosed and fixed the 'no module named sqlite available within module root' compile error. framework/events/editor_bus.zig:38 imports sqlite as a NAMED module (deliberate, so it can be built in isolation for its unit test). build.zig wired that name only on the isolated test module (editor_bus_mod_t.addImport), but the host build reaches editor_bus.zig via a relative-import chain (v8_ingredients -> v8_bindings_editor_bus -> editor_bus.zig), compiling it into root_mod, which never had a 'sqlite' named module registered. Fix: created editor_sqlite_root_mod from framework/storage/sqlite.zig and registered it via root_mod.addImport("sqlite", ...) right after the zluajit import, so both build paths resolve the name. No source change to editor_bus.zig; sqlite.zig dlopens libsqlite3 with no link-time dep. Needs a fresh ship to verify (build.zig change, not hot-reload covered).
